start_connect_intro: With Claude Code, using an API key from the admin area:
start_connect_other: Other clients and the HTTP routes:
field_path: Path in the repository (empty for the whole repository)
field_exclusions: Exclusions: glob patterns relative to the repository root, one per line
field_schedule: Schedule: cron expression with five fields, empty for the global one ({schedule})
field_paused: Paused: polling skips this source, only "Sync now" syncs it
field_token_stored: Access token (stored; leave empty to keep it)
field_token_entered: Access token (entered; leave empty to keep it)
setup_intro: Choose the admin account. The setup token is in the server log.
password_changed: Password changed. Every other session was logged out.
apikeys_created: Key for {name} created. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
apikeys_revoke_question: Revoke the key {name}? Agents using it lose access at once.
apikeys_error_scope: Choose all projects or at least one.
apikeys_error_project_gone: A selected project no longer exists.
admin_all_fine: Every source is synced without errors or warnings.
project_delete_question: Delete project {slug} with all its sources?
source_polling_paused: paused; only "Sync now" syncs this source
wizard_nothing_saved: Nothing is saved until you create the project.
error_slug_rule: The slug may contain lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. auth-service.
error_project_slug_taken: A project with the slug "{slug}" already exists.
error_source_slug_taken: This project already has a source with the slug "{slug}".
error_path: The path is relative to the repository root and may not contain "..".
error_token_other_server: The Git URL points to another server: enter the token again or remove it.
error_git_url_https: The Git URL must start with https://.
error_git_url_credentials: Enter the username and token in their own fields, not in the Git URL.
auth_wrong_setup_token: Wrong setup token. It is in the server log.
auth_password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
auth_new_password_too_short: The new password needs at least {min} characters.
auth_blocked: Too many failed logins. Try again later.
